name: Tawaf
summary: A broad flowing orbit gathers around a clear Kaaba center, expressing direction, devotion, and continuity.
why: The compact Kaaba remains still while one open circular gesture moves around it. Broad planes and a gold band keep the sacred center recognizable. The open orbit gives the identity a sense of movement without a crowded scene.
risk: The circular form can also suggest a cycle or refresh symbol. The Kaaba establishes the Islamic meaning, most clearly in color and at launcher size.
reasonToChoose: A clear Islamic symbol and a feeling of continuity should lead.
